title: How to Export/Import Text Labels via Database
text:
## How to Export/Import Text Labels via Database
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000089230
This article covers how to import and export text labels from one site to another using the database. This can be a good workaround for site owners with multiple sites in different languages, where all translated text labels can be transferred from one site to another.

## 1) How to Export Text Labels
To accomplish this, navigate to Developer Hub >> MySQL Database :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12184814442/original/d-FO7idgMu_nQxcobg5iwoZCQzaEoqxSLQ.png?1788804440 | alt: ]
Click on the _directory database:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12184814478/original/WJyDBuTjlTDJ5OwO__WD4yv_EY2h1ZnbFQ.png?1788804477 | alt: ]
Search for the table website_labels and click on it:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12112838030/original/mqxi2oi8DH0x1SW_XPwSzJO2i5vctpX_Hg.png?1660050459 | alt: ]
Click on the Export navigation link:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12112838073/original/HSXVfeXmBbDNHnjYPL4MMe5aFnRXRMve8w.png?1660050502 | alt: ]
Choose the Custom option:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12112838121/original/exU0GFpduHj93lQr3G-nzRUhPLUHHXtuyA.png?1660050536 | alt: ]
Name the file and choose the gzipped Compression option:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12112838224/original/RoCnIReRLitKvwxatTnByg5FJgEdlhqbAQ.png?1660050599 | alt: ]
Select the Add Drop Table / Trigger statement option:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12112838283/original/bc5mnbnuRVNDKICGeUpMDMdUjL0RVm_HDw.png?1660050646 | alt: ]
Clicking on Go downloads the file:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12112838296/original/1zUAxJF7epkLa6lq1JTtQAdXDoQRiNP94Q.png?1660050680 | alt: ]

## 2) How to Import Text Labels
Now that the export file is ready and downloaded, the next step is to navigate to a different site where these text labels will be imported.
To accomplish this, navigate to Developer Hub >> MySQL Database :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12112838977/original/lkFRM4ip0QHiCuCehUQteMDOuSnCRsJ2Uw.png?1660051271 | alt: ]
Click on the _directory database:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12112839015/original/1urpoCb5ZoHfQgAiSJj2UkMz-ha2ikXa8A.png?1660051298 | alt: ]
Click on the Import navigation link:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12112839063/original/a43lYOr9o8d89GiYQMMDE5sP9yOq8gXZDw.png?1660051349 | alt: ]
Choose the correct exported file and click on Go :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12112839122/original/RwVlApRGYuHGYRh0wJgrNWEwkFp06wRgkg.png?1660051395 | alt: ]
There will be an indication that the queries were executed correctly:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12112839187/original/Eg_LfMM8Ks9Dm4Z2xcHCQf9dsCB2nR2MjQ.png?1660051443 | alt: ]
